summary: You store the assistant's chunks in Postgres: a chunks table with metadata, a ChunkStore class that owns the SQL (safe table name, parameters, upsert, HNSW index), an ingest you can run twice, one SQL query that returns the nearest 3 chunks, and tests that skip when the database is not running.
goal: Store chunks with their metadata in Postgres, and return the nearest 3 with one SQL query.

items.text: Part A: write down the columns, the unique constraint and what ChunkStore must offer
Part B: start the database and check it is healthy
Parts C and D: write store.py and ingest.py, run ingest twice and see 26 rows both times
Parts E and F: ask three questions and run the one SQL query for the nearest 3 chunks
Part G: write three tests and see them pass, then see two skipped with the database stopped
Parts H and I: stop the database to see the error, add the README and note, then commit and push
Play the Chunk Store Check game to the end and see your score
